description: Defines an immutable data object for loan charge data within the Fineract project, including various constructors, helper methods, and logic for charge calculations and status checks.

classes.name: LoanChargeData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing loan charge details, including constructors, static factory methods, and logic for charge status and calculations.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template LoanChargeData with specified charge options.

methods.name: newLoanChargeDetails
methods.description: Creates a new LoanChargeData populated with charge definition details for CRUD operations.

methods.name: isChargePayable
methods.description: Determines if the charge is payable based on payment mode and status.

methods.name: isInstallmentFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an installment fee based on charge time type.

methods.name: updateAmountAccrued
methods.description: Updates the amount accrued for the charge.
